content: {"summary":"Customers report long wait times and incorrect name changes on their SkyMiles accounts [#tk_2580965]. They also face issues with missing mileage credits for partner flights, such as the LAX‑TPE leg not applying [#tk_446151]. Users struggle to reset passwords or create new accounts, citing a broken password reset page and lack of options for new members [#tk_1158704] [#tk_2094948]. Additionally, many are frustrated by delayed MQM crediting and unclear status‑defer policies [#tk_660653] [#tk_521832]."}
